steps.title: Drawn by Hand
steps.body: Molten wax is applied with a canting pen, tracing each motif line by line before a single drop of dye touches the cloth.

steps.title: Dyed in Stages
steps.body: The cloth is submerged, dried and re-waxed through repeated baths — every colour a separate immersion, built up over days.

steps.title: Cotton & Silk
steps.body: We print on a cotton–silk blend: the cotton breathes and holds the dye, the silk lends the drape and quiet sheen of a dress shirt.
